lines: [gasps] [excited] Rocco! Someone just sent me a THOUSAND dollars!
[calm] In five seconds, you'll get a text. [pause] Oops, wrong person! Please send it back!
[sweet] [fake innocent] Oopsie! Wrong person! Please send it back!
[pushy] [fast] Quick, quick! It's for my grandma's... rent! Her... surgery! Her rent surgery!
[dryly] Red flag. He paid you with a stolen card.
The real owner reports it... [pause] and the bank takes the thousand back.
[nervous] So if I send him a thousand too...
[deadpan] You're down a thousand. He keeps it.
[panicked] [whiny] DOWN?! I was rich for five minutes!
[warmly] Your move: send nothing. Report it in your payment app, and let the app send it back.
[suspicious] Hey, mister. What's your name, anyway?
[panicked] Wait, wait! I'll send you TWO thousand!
